preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, the number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000, and the number of edges m must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= s <= n and 1 <= t <= n and s != t
preconditions.description: The start vertex s and end vertex t must be valid vertices in the graph and must be different.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of paths from s to t with lengths differing from the shortest path by no more than 1, modulo 10^9 + 7.
